label: Local axioms 5 and 4 at the selected world give axiom 5 at its successors
meaning: Frame-theoretic locator for the dialectical value of Euclidean access at the actual world (F2'), not a route step. With transitivity at w the successor set of w is closed, so (with reflexivity at w) the subframe generated by w is Euclidean. Hence a view accepting F2' but rejecting global Euclidean access must, for modal truth at w, deny local axiom 4 at w, or reject Euclidean access only at worlds w cannot reach. No premise is established; both are OPEN frame conditions.
